operator_fb: 처음엔 맨주먹으로 싸우는데 싸우는 모션이 아예 없음. 멜리/맨주먹 공격이 데미지만 주고 시각 모션 없음 (B10 attack-lunge 미작동 의심).
root_cause: B10 PawnPoseDriver lunge wrote bodyChild.localPosition.x in Update, but PawnSpriteBob.Update writes the FULL localPosition vector every frame as (baseLocalPos.x, baseY+bob, baseZ) — hard-resetting X to baseLocalPos.x. Two Update writers + full-vector reset = lunge X clobbered same frame → zero visible motion.

PawnPoseDriver lunge was proximity-gated (attacking && !lungeActive); 'attacking' stays continuously true while an enemy sits in range, so it fired at most ONCE then never re-triggered per swing. Only watched BanditEnemy (no wolf/animal) + DraftedAttackTarget.
fix: New CombatLungeDriver.cs writes the lunge X in LateUpdate (runs AFTER all four pose drivers' Update — confirmed all use Update), making it the authoritative LAST writer of bodyChild.localPosition.x. Reads post-bob localPosition, writes ONLY X, preserves Y (bob) and Z. Root transform never touched.

Lunge is HIT-driven: PawnEntity.RegisterMeleeHit stamps LastMeleeHitTime + unit direction on each ACTUAL auto-attack tick; CombatLungeDriver POLLS LastMeleeHitTime (no event subscribe — bug #7) and edge-detects to re-fire per swing.

Drafted-melee fallback in CombatLungeDriver edge-fires on its own cadence when PawnEntity reports a live drafted target (bandit/wolf/animal via public DraftedAttackTarget/DraftedWolfTarget/DraftedHuntTarget) within melee range — animates wolf/animal swings WITHOUT editing PawnUtilityAI (out of lane). Suppressed at ranged distance (archer shoots arrow, no jab).

Hit-flash: brief brightness pulse on the body child renderer at the lunge peak, multiplied off the current ROOT color (TintHelper lesson #167 — never flat-white overwrite), restored to root color when flash ends so PawnSpriteBob's color mirror re-asserts cleanly.
PawnEntity gains public LastMeleeHitTime / LastMeleeHitDir / LastAttackWasMelee / IsAttacking (fulfils B10 FLAG-B10-3 missing-accessor request).

outputs.description: Self-bootstrapping (RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod AfterSceneLoad + PawnMovement sweep behind GameSceneGate.RunWhenGameScene; [DisallowMultipleComponent]). Hit-driven forward lunge (0.2 world units, 0.16s ease-back) on body child localPosition.x in LateUpdate + brief hit-flash. Time-throttled inside LateUpdate (no WaitForSeconds — bug #9 safe). No root transform write.

Added public LastMeleeHitTime/LastMeleeHitDir/LastAttackWasMelee + RegisterMeleeHit(targetWorldPos, melee) + IsAttacking accessor. Auto-attack hit in Update now calls RegisterMeleeHit(nearest.transform.position, melee:true). No change to death/downed tint (ApplyVisual) or selection logic.

lane_compliance.PawnActions_cs_reason: Inspected — contains zero melee-attack code (all IPawnAction classes are work tasks). Actual melee lives in PawnEntity.Update (edited) + PawnUtilityAI.HandleDraftedCombat (out of lane, covered by CombatLungeDriver drafted fallback).

firewall_audit.bug4_audio_loop: n/a (no AudioBank calls). Lunge re-trigger throttled by lungeMinInterval — per-swing not per-frame.
firewall_audit.bug6_collisionenter_only: n/a (no collision handlers; range polling like PawnEntity).
firewall_audit.bug7_singleton_subscription: PASS — CombatLungeDriver POLLS PawnEntity.LastMeleeHitTime + PawnHealth.State every LateUpdate; subscribes to nothing.
firewall_audit.bug9_runinbackground_freeze: PASS — throttle is Time-based inside LateUpdate; no WaitForSeconds/always-on background timer introduced.

writer_ownership_extension.localPosition.X: CombatLungeDriver (LateUpdate, authoritative last writer — supersedes PawnPoseDriver's stomped Update write)
writer_ownership_extension.localRotation: PawnPoseDriver (corpse roll; CombatLungeDriver early-outs on dead/downed)
writer_ownership_extension.flipX: PawnFacing (CombatLungeDriver READS to mirror lunge direction when target is directly above/below)
writer_ownership_extension.color: PawnSpriteBob mirror + brief CombatLungeDriver flash (restored to root color after flash so mirror re-asserts)

flags_for_qa.description: Two lunge implementations now coexist: B10 PawnPoseDriver (Update, stomped by PawnSpriteBob so visually inert) and CombatLungeDriver (LateUpdate, authoritative). CombatLungeDriver wins every frame. Recommend a follow-up to remove the now-dead UpdateAttackLunge from PawnPoseDriver (out of this lane — PawnPoseDriver is the Art/B10 lane). No functional conflict because CombatLungeDriver writes localPosition.x LAST.

Drafted bandit/wolf/animal melee + auto-attack on bandits both animate. Drafted hits use a range+cadence fallback (not a PawnUtilityAI stamp) because PawnUtilityAI is out of lane. If a future lane edits PawnUtilityAI.HandleDraftedCombat, calling entity.RegisterMeleeHit(target.transform.position, true) on each TakeDamage there would make drafted lunges frame-accurate too (the fallback would then no-op via the lungeMinInterval throttle).
